newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber up on firmer Thai rubber offer price.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber up on firmer Thai rubber offer price.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly firmer on Tuesday, supported by higher Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and the yen's fall against the dollar late in the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 3.3 yen per kg higher. The benchmark August contract was flat at 152.4 yen.

Prices opened firmer across the board, lifted by short-covering. "Today's firmer Thai offer prices to Japan, and growing expectations that the Thai government will intervene in the market to prop up raw material prices in Thailand, underpinned market sentiment here," a trader said.
